thread:
Nora Patel: Quick check 903 (private deploy) invoice INV-2026-05-31 shows platform fee true-up + automated enforcement fee labeled 'support enforcement' $4,500. Customer says no enforcement actions were taken. Anyone know what that line is?

Samir Rao: enforcement fee usually from breach remediation (we retained ops to fix connectivity in their VPC). Did PS open a remediation engagement?

Ivy Tran: PS did a support hotfix on May 20-21 to apply a network change after a customer misconfigured firewall. We billed an ad-hoc enforcement labor fee previously but that should have been ticketed to professional services, not enforcement.

Nora Patel: that explains it; customer thought it was covered under support. can we reclass the line to 'Professional Services - incident remediation' and credit the enforcement label?

Samir Rao: reclassing is fine but must preserve revenue recognition mapping. I'll request accounting reclass journal and issue a corrected invoice with note.

collections-bot: Invoice INV-2026-05-31 current status: paid. Correction requires issuing a credit memo and re-billing the corrected invoice. link: https://s3.redwood/internal/invoices/INV-2026-05-31.pdf

Nora Patel: customer also requested the breakdown of hours. Ivy can you confirm hours spent?

Ivy Tran: 3 engineers for 6 hours each across two days, total 36 engineer-hours. billing rate used historically for enforcement: $125/hr; PS rate: $185/hr. we should bill PS at $185/hr if we reclass, which increases the charge. Customer will push back.

Samir Rao: hmm reclass increases cost. better to credit the enforcement fee $4,500 and absorb as one-time write-off and offer a discounted PS re-bill at $3,000 to keep it simple.

Nora Patel: finance policy: write-offs under $5k can be approved by manager. @Samir can you prepare the credit memo for $4,500 and propose the discounted invoice?

Samir Rao: will draft credit memo and new invoice for $3,000 re-bill. Ivy please confirm that $3,000 is acceptable to PS.

Ivy Tran: $3k covers a 25% discount, PS okay with that for customer retention.

Nora Patel: proceed. I'll update AR and collections note that payment allocation will remain as paid and credit will be applied to next billing cycle.

collections-bot: Credit memo CM-2026-06-05 created for INV-2026-05-31 amount $4,500. Allocation pending.
